extracted.intended_audience: public information officers (PIOs) at research institutions and organizations that produce scientific news releases; working reporters and scientific publishers who use EurekAlert!
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and platform standards for submitting, hosting, and accessing scientific news releases on the EurekAlert! distribution platform, including contributor eligibility, content types, embargo handling, fees, and processing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: News release eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases must meet EurekAlert!'s longstanding eligibility guidelines in order to be accepted and hosted on the website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly refers contributors to the full 'news release eligibility guidelines' (www.eurekalert.org/releaseguidelines) for substantive rules. Meeting the guidelines is a prerequisite to acceptance; simply paying a submission fee does not guarantee acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributor identity requirement (PIO-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! only accepts content contributions from public information officers (PIOs) at eligible organizations that conduct, publish, or fund scientific research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIOs wishing to submit releases must meet EurekAlert!'s eligibility criteria, complete the online application form, and pay a submission fee. The site does not accept submissions from individuals who are not PIOs of eligible organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission fee and non-guarantee of acceptance
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must pay a fee to submit news releases to EurekAlert!. Payment of submission fees does not guarantee acceptance of news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even after payment, releases are subject to the platform's eligibility review. The page emphasizes fee payment as a required administrative step but not as approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of acceptable content
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! hosts news releases describing research findings recently published in peer-reviewed journals, timely information related to the business, innovation, and societal aspects of science, and details of grants, awards and honors, books, and scientific meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform also hosts online newsrooms/microsites for journal publishers, government agencies, meetings and other organizations; acceptable content spans disciplines and may include a range of science-related timely information beyond primary research summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online newsroom / microsite hosting
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! hosts online newsrooms or news portals for journal publishers, government agencies, scientific meetings and other organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These microsites aggregate news releases published by, or relevant to, the host organization or meeting and provide a way for organizations to group and present releases on the EurekAlert! platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporter-only (embargoed) access eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Working reporters who meet our eligibility criteria may apply for free access to the reporter-only section on EurekAlert!, which hosts embargoed news releases and press materials provided by academic journals and research institutions for the exclusive use of working journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters must meet platform eligibility to gain reporter-only access; that access includes embargoed materials and services intended exclusively for working journalists prior to public embargo release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo release policy
rubrics_metrics.description: All embargoed news releases are made freely available to the public at designated embargo-release time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While reporters with reporter-only access can see embargoed materials in advance, embargoed items are scheduled to become publicly available at the embargo-release time specified by the provider.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporter services (alerts and feeds)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporters gain access to services such as customizable daily e-mail alerts of embargoed news releases and a reporter-only section with embargoed materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Working reporters who qualify can sign up for tailored services (e.g., daily e-mail alerts) to track embargoed content; public feeds are also available for general consumption.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO services and submission access
rubrics_metrics.description: Working public information officers (PIOs) who meet eligibility criteria may apply for free access to certain services on EurekAlert! and purchase access to submit news releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIOs must apply and, if needed, purchase submission access; some services are free while submission capability requires payment/purchase as described on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing times and office hours
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert!'s office hours are 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday (excluding holidays). Submissions or inquiries received by staff during office hours will be processed the same day. Submissions received outside of office hours will be processed on the next business day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact methods provided include e-mail (webmaster@eurekalert.org) and phone (1-202-326-6716); timing expectations for processing are explicitly stated and should be observed for time-sensitive releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public access to news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases hosted on EurekAlert! are freely available to members of the public at www.eurekalert.org. No registration necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The general public can access non-embargoed content without registration; embargoed content is restricted until the embargo-release time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multilingual release support
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! provides multi-language news releases (examples listed: Japanese, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site lists language-specific news sections (日本語, 中文, En Français, Auf Deutsch, En Español, Em português), indicating support for publishing and/or aggregating releases in multiple languages and regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorization by subject and region
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases are organized by subject (e.g., Agriculture, Biology, Medicine & Health, Tech & Engineering) and by region (e.g., Africa, Latin America, Japan, China).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters should expect to assign releases to subject and regional categories so that releases appear in the appropriate topical and geographic feeds; the site provides enumerated categories for this purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Findability and staying updated (feeds and newsletters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can follow the latest releases via a real-time feed, sign up for the #EurekAlertTrending Weekly Newsletter, and follow EurekAlert! on social media (Twitter, Facebook, Weibo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters and journalists can use these distribution and discovery channels to increase reach; EurekAlert! editorial curation (e.g., #EurekAlertStaffPicks) is also available for visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform policies and legal terms
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! links to and operates under policies including Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, DMCA, and Disclaimer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors and users are expected to comply with EurekAlert!'s privacy and legal policies; the page points to full policy documents for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to read full release guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: You may read our news release eligibility guidelines at www.eurekalert.org/releaseguidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This explicit pointer indicates that the detailed, authoritative rules for what makes an acceptable release are contained on the linked guidelines page; submitters should consult that page for the full rubric and procedural requirements.
